title: אבא אחיו של רבן גמליאל

paragraphs: Abba, brother of Rabban Gamliel. He married the daughter of his brother Rabban Gamliel, died, and Rabban Gamliel contracted levirate marriage with her co-wife (Yevamot 15a). It appears that he was the brother of Rabban Gamliel of Yavneh (see what I wrote there). If so, in chronological order he should precede Abba bar Abba the priest, mentioned below.
